description: Hourly solar output and a curtailment estimate for ERCOT, from ERCOT's own solar production report (NP4-745-CD), back to January 2024. Curtailment is a proxy: system-wide available solar (HSL) minus actual output over midday hours 10-17, as a percent of available. ERCOT does not publish regional or per-plant curtailment here, so regions (FarWest, NorthWest, CenterWest, CenterEast, FarEast, SouthEast) show output and midday shape only. Use for 'how much solar gets curtailed', 'is solar output growing', 'what is the midday solar shape in West Texas', 'worst curtailment days'. Free: the last 30 days system-wide curtailment percent and each region's share of solar output. Pro: monthly history by region or system, the 30-day hourly shape, the worst hours of each month and the daily curtailment series.

months.description: Months of history for Pro. Default 12, max 36.

region.description: SystemWide (default), FarWest, NorthWest, CenterWest, CenterEast, FarEast or SouthEast.
